bibl.title: Epitaph of Merki Found in Hambukol.
bibl.seg: Adam Łajtar, Epitaph of Merki Found in Hambukol.
bibl.note: Royal Ontario Museum, Toronto, Inv. 998.89.7. Epitaph of Merki, who followed a splendid career in the state apparatus, which led from notarios to protodomestikos, i.e. the head of the royal office dealing with agriculture and fiscal matters. Hambukol (a village on the right bank of the Nile, 7 km to the north of the ruins of Dongola), ninth century.
